correctness.rationale: Exact balanced substitution-block identity reduces a length B^(e+1) Parikh deviation to two boundary prefixes. The addition-of-B^e digit-carry identity gives shift 1+c mod m. In aligned digit blocks one unrestricted base-B digit enforces conditional uniform starting letters because m divides B, and the carry-tail density tends to zero. Geometric summation yields the explicitly normalized all-exponent rational distribution. The proper-interval injection gives the perfect-balance formula, and complementary arcs prove sign symmetry. Actual included verify.py returned VERIFY_OK checks= 199 and checked eight parameter pairs by exact fractions, multiple substitution-generated prefix samples, and finite carry-block enumerations; the infinite result rests on the proof.

value.rationale: Substitution-power factors and abelian/additive observables are canonical for this family, and known research largely counts supported classes. The theorem gives the full probability measure instead: it provides a simple rational formula simultaneously for unbounded scales and an infinite family of bases, a nontrivial exact stationarity phenomenon, an explicit probability of perfect balance, and all weighted letter-sum marginals. These distinctions carry information absent from support counts and are useful for testing statistical conjectures about morphic words.
